purpose: Read-only M2-W2 P0-B attribution audit of the v14 candidate; this contract authorizes no training, calibration, checkpoint selection, or model mutation.

train_token_directory_identity_contract.digest_framing: array name ASCII, NumPy dtype.str ASCII, little-endian int64 shape, then C-contiguous payload bytes

base_anchor.semantics: immutable P0-A code anchor; the P0-B runtime HEAD must descend from it

stage_commit_boundaries: frozen P0-B audit contract and integrity helpers
strict train-only satellite and ISR loaders
P0-B read-only runner and runner tests
P0-B attribution conclusions and plan update

p0a_dependency_exception.authorization: GIRO may continue in the background; P0-B may start without waiting for it.
p0c_unlock_requires: P0-A final acceptance including GIRO and fixed observation eligibility, unless the user issues a later explicit waiver
all six P0-B attribution questions assigned an allowed terminal status

satellite_tokens.profile_partition_semantics: profile representative UTC day from the frozen date split

satellite_profile_index_metadata.access_mode: read-only classification and aggregate of existing profile-index metadata
satellite_profile_index_metadata.assimilation_token_effect: none; all assimilation tokens remain train-only

locked_test_classification_metadata.purpose: transient partition classification, output-boundary integrity validation, and exclusion only

ISR_queries.query_mask: finite ISR density and finite model coordinates within 120--500 km
ISR_queries.locked_test_exclusion_stage: timestamp metadata may be read only to classify UTC columns; locked-test density columns are excluded before materialization, model query, token lookup, cache creation, or aggregation

restricted_mixed_file_identity.materialized_allowed_content_digest_fram: SHA256 over the schema prefix and ordered length-framed arrays; each frame binds logical name, NumPy dtype.str, shape, C order, and C-contiguous payload bytes

partitioning.completion_semantics: write all NPZ artifacts and summaries first; atomically write the contract-listed completion marker last

output_lifecycle.full_audit_precondition: an explicit completed preflight_acceptance.json bound to the identical implementation tag object, HEAD, checkpoint, P0-A/P0-B/date-split identities, query/profile counts, coordinate/profile-cap state, source provenance, and Python environment
output_lifecycle.failed_directory_policy: preserve and permanently retire the failed directory
output_lifecycle.retry_policy: only an explicitly authorized new revision directory may be used

preflight_probe.cost_risk_note: the 12 inference probes are small, but their prerequisite ISR registry and FY/COSMIC train-only compact indexes have full-scope I/O and memory cost

query.string_storage: fixed-width Unicode arrays; object arrays are forbidden

token.row_unit: one unique source-profile-token identity within a batch

edge.row_unit: one unique query-token relation in the unmodified production payload

mode_semantics.M00: P0-B Background with no Analysis observations, evaluated at each raw finite ISR train/development query
mode_semantics.no_token: an actual forward pass with both observation payloads absent; must be bitwise identical to M00
mode_semantics.M10: FY-only isolated solve using the same Background, query anomalies, FY innovation, and FY precision as the joint forward
mode_semantics.M01: COSMIC-only isolated solve using the same Background, query anomalies, COSMIC innovation, and COSMIC precision as the joint forward
mode_semantics.M11: joint FY+COSMIC solve using the frozen v14 equation and train-only P0-B audit tokens; it is an attribution diagnostic and must never be presented as the P0-A formal candidate value
mode_semantics.joint_update_FY_dex: FY contribution solved with the M11 joint system; it is not M10-M00
mode_semantics.joint_update_COSMIC_dex: COSMIC contribution solved with the M11 joint system; it is not M01-M00
mode_semantics.raw_coverage_code: source presence is determined by production-payload token_count > 0, before any precision test
mode_semantics.coverage_code: effective source presence is determined by localized_precision_sum > 0; this is the update-capable coverage used in attribution
mode_semantics.zero_localized_precision_semantics: raw_coverage_code may show a source while coverage_code does not; such queries are low/zero-gain candidates, not true no-observation payloads

precision_innovation_gain_semantics.r_variance_dex2: the frozen source observation variance before localization
precision_innovation_gain_semantics.localized_precision: unlocalized_precision * localization_weight; this equals the v14 production precision
precision_innovation_gain_semantics.capped_precision_reporting: forbidden; no profile cap exists in the audited checkpoint
precision_innovation_gain_semantics.prior_predictive_variance_dex2: sum of squared observation ensemble anomalies divided by N-1, without localization
precision_innovation_gain_semantics.predictive_nis_unlocalized_formula: d^T P d - (Y^T P d)^T ((N-1)I + Y^T P Y)^-1 (Y^T P d)
precision_innovation_gain_semantics.predictive_nis_unlocalized_precision: P is the unlocalized diagonal-R precision representativeness_weight / r_variance_dex2 on valid tokens; localization_weight is excluded

predictive_nis_unlocalized_modes.joint: concatenate FY and COSMIC tokens before constructing the single joint system

precision_innovation_gain_semantics.predictive_nis_unlocalized_dof: number of tokens in the named mode with unlocalized diagonal-R precision > 0; only predictive_nis_unlocalized/dof is a per-dof diagnostic
precision_innovation_gain_semantics.predictive_nis_naming_guard: predictive_diagonal_nis and r_standardized_innovation_sq are per-edge diagnostics and are not the complete query-level predictive NIS; no localization-weighted quantity may be named NIS
precision_innovation_gain_semantics.localized_innovation_energy: localization_weight * r_standardized_innovation_sq; this field must never be called NIS
precision_innovation_gain_semantics.gain_joint: edge gain from the M11 joint-system Cholesky solve
precision_innovation_gain_semantics.gain_isolated: edge gain recomputed from the corresponding M10 or M01 source-only system
closure: sum(edge contribution_joint_dex by query and source) equals the matching joint_update source field
sum(edge contribution_isolated_dex by query and source) equals the matching isolated increment field

precision_statistics.profile_precision: sum token localized_precision within query x source x profile

zero_precision_result.storage_semantics: NPZ forbids object arrays; -1 is valid only when the paired boolean valid field is false

counterfactuals.solver_semantics: rebuild source covariance and RHS from original observation anomalies, innovation, and modified precision multipliers, then solve again; subtracting fixed original gain contributions is forbidden

duplicate_profile.operation: multiply all original precision-bearing edges of the selected profile by 2, representing one exact duplicate
duplicate_profile.edge_table_rule: the production edge table remains deduplicated; duplication exists only as a counterfactual multiplier and query output

derived_long_tables.query_regime: one row per query for IRI/M00/M10/M01/M11, counterfactual, ISR-error, and low-altitude diagnostics; it has no source dimension
derived_long_tables.query_source: two derived rows per query labelled FY and COSMIC for source-specific token, profile, precision, N_eff, innovation, gain, isolated increment, and joint-source update diagnostics
derived_long_tables.query_joint: one derived row per query labelled joint only for joint predictive NIS, M11-M00, and joint counterfactual diagnostics

fixed_aggregation.independence_rule: edge or token count must never be reported as the independent sample count
fixed_aggregation.Q6_until_fixed_observation_eligibility: insufficient_evidence; no common-valid model mask may upgrade Q6 while the observation-only eligibility contract is pending

decision_rules.independent_unit: station-time profile with date block retained; query, token, edge, and height rows are nested technical observations

Q1_bias_origin.terminal_logic: supported for exactly one material origin label across eligible cells; mixed for multiple or cell-dependent material labels; not_supported when none is material; insufficient_evidence when no eligible cell

Q2_increment_consistency.direction_reference: sign of M11-M00 versus sign of the localized-precision-weighted FY+COSMIC innovation, reduced with equal station-time-profile weight
Q2_increment_consistency.closure_role: hard QA guard only; closure is not attribution evidence
Q2_increment_consistency.low_gain_and_source_cancellation_role: explanatory diagnostics for small net increments; they do not decide direction-consistency status
Q2_increment_consistency.defined_evidence_gate: direction, raw/effective low-gain, and source-cancellation evidence are each eligible only with at least 30 defined station-time profiles across at least 2 unique dates
Q2_increment_consistency.terminal_logic: among material eligible cells, direction evidence below the defined profile/date gate is ineligible; supported when every eligible direction cell meets the frozen threshold; not_supported when every eligible direction cell fails; mixed when eligible cells disagree or material cells mix eligible and ineligible direction evidence; insufficient_evidence when there is no material eligible cell or no eligible direction evidence

Q3_profile_precision_concentration.defined_evidence_gate: concentration and duplicate-profile evidence are each eligible only with at least 30 defined station-time profiles across at least 2 unique dates; either failure makes the cell ineligible
Q3_profile_precision_concentration.terminal_logic: supported when concentration and duplicate-profile sensitivity co-occur in at least one eligible cell and neither is contradicted in another eligible cell; mixed when only one flag occurs or co-occurrence is cell/source dependent; not_supported when neither flag occurs in any eligible cell; insufficient_evidence when no eligible cell

Q5_low_altitude_drift.terminal_logic: supported when material low-altitude M11-M00 drift and high-altitude-token deletion sensitivity co-occur in an eligible cell without contradiction; mixed when only one occurs or cells disagree; not_supported when neither occurs in any eligible cell; insufficient_evidence when no eligible low-altitude cell

qd.reason: not installed in the frozen pytorch_cpu P0-B environment

coordinate_enrichment.missing_coordinate_policy: required AACGM values must be finite; QD is explicitly unavailable and geographic or AACGM latitude may not be relabeled as QD

questions.text: Does the bias first appear in M00, a specific source, or a specific condition?
questions.interpretation_boundary: Locates the numerical stage at which median bias becomes material within the audited ISR cells.
questions.supports: Retrospective stage-level attribution among Raw IRI, M00, isolated FY/COSMIC increments, and joint interaction.
questions.does_not_support: Does not establish FY or COSMIC sensor bias, causal observation error, or out-of-sample correction benefit.

questions.text: Is the M11 increment direction consistent with innovation, precision, and gain?
questions.interpretation_boundary: Tests algebraic direction consistency and separately gated low-gain/cancellation mechanisms on defined station-time profiles.
questions.supports: Whether frozen v14 increments align with localized-precision-weighted innovations in eligible cells.
questions.does_not_support: Does not show that an update is closer to truth, causally beneficial, or optimally localized.

questions.text: Does within-profile token count dominate total precision or update magnitude?
questions.interpretation_boundary: Tests whether profile-level precision concentration co-occurs with sensitivity to one exact duplicate under frozen v14.
questions.supports: Retrospective evidence that profile multiplicity can dominate effective precision or update magnitude.
questions.does_not_support: Does not identify the physical R covariance, prove raw duplicate records, or calibrate a profile cap.

questions.text: Can source coverage be separated from latitude and magnetic-coordinate effects?
questions.interpretation_boundary: Two fixed stations cannot separate source coverage from geographic or magnetic-latitude effects.
questions.supports: Only descriptive source and coordinate stratification.
questions.does_not_support: Does not estimate causal source, latitude, or topology effects.

questions.text: Does the 120--200 km output drift with high-altitude token coverage, innovation, or counterfactual removal?
questions.interpretation_boundary: Separates 120--200 km Analysis coupling to 200--500 km tokens from material M00/Raw IRI background error.
questions.supports: Routing evidence for V_low_AN, V_low_BG_or_IRI_anchor, mixed, or deprioritized follow-up.
questions.does_not_support: Does not validate a low-altitude correction, change the no-satellite-target status of 120--200 km, or identify the causal anchor.

questions.text: Does the hmF2 problem persist after explicit boundary, weak-peak, and ambiguous-peak accounting?
questions.interpretation_boundary: Peak persistence remains untestable until observation-only hmF2 eligibility is fixed.
questions.supports: Only records the unresolved eligibility dependency.
questions.does_not_support: Does not compare peak skill, unlock V_peak, or support a causal peak-shape claim.

acceptance.failure_policy: preserve the failed directory, report NO-GO, and do not restart or change the frozen contract automatically

prohibitions: R or bias calibration from ISR

locked-test density, model inference, predictions, reports, or cache reads; the only exception is the contract-enumerated transient date/profile-index classification metadata, which may not be persisted or aggregated
P0-A NPZ, peak-cache, or numeric-output join
automatic restart, threshold change, or counterfactual redefinition
unlocking P0-C while the dependency exception remains unresolved
